title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Instalment Invoicing, Due Dates and Disputes
content:
## Accounts receivable memorandum

**Invoicing.** The annual price of a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record is invoiced on the tier's billing frequency, in equal installments over the agreement year, with any remainder cent carried onto the first installment. Each installment is the annual price divided by the tier's installment count, rounded to the cent; the frequency and count are the tier's figures on the terms sheet.

**Due date.** Each invoice falls due the tier's payment term after the invoice date, counted in calendar days with the invoice day excluded and the due day included. On a 30-day term an invoice dated 3 May falls due on 2 June.

**Disputes.** Where a customer disputes an invoice in writing, the late fee on the disputed amount stops accruing from the day the dispute is recorded and resumes from the day it is resolved against them.

### Clauses of this memorandum that are no longer in force

The following three clauses have been superseded by the current basis and are **no longer in force**; they are recorded here so that they are not applied.

1. "An installment still unpaid after its due day carries the tier's late fee on the unpaid amount for each month or part month it stays unpaid, applied on the same day of each following month." — no longer in force. The tier's late fee rate on the terms sheet remains a published figure of the tier.
2. "Payments are applied to the oldest unpaid invoice first, then to ancillary fees in the order they were charged; a customer may direct a payment to a named invoice instead, and where they do, that direction governs." — no longer in force.
3. "Credits are applied to the next installment invoice and never paid out in cash." — no longer in force.

### Instalment illustration (hypothetical)

An annual price of 2890 USD at a tier billed quarterly in 4 installments: 2890 USD divided by 4 is 722.50 USD, so four installments of 722.50 USD are invoiced. An annual price of 1001 USD billed monthly in 12 installments: 1001 USD divided by 12 is 83.41 USD to the cent, twelve of which total 1000.92 USD, so the remainder of 0.08 USD is carried onto the first installment, which is invoiced at 83.49 USD.

superseded_clauses: An installment still unpaid after its due day carries the tier's late fee on the unpaid amount for each month or part month it stays unpaid, applied on the same day of each following month.

Payments are applied to the oldest unpaid invoice first, then to ancillary fees in the order they were charged; a customer may direct a payment to a named invoice instead, and where they do, that direction governs.
Credits are applied to the next installment invoice and never paid out in cash.
